body_en: I hear you have a new class this week. How do you like it? Tell me what you do there.
I go to that shop every day. It is small but very good. What do you buy when you go to a shop?
I want to know how your work is going. Write to me and say what you have done. If it is hard, we can talk about it.
There is a change at work next week, and I am not sure I understand it. Can you call me later and tell me what you think? I would like to hear from you.
I am making a plan for the group and I need your view on it. Would you look at it and send me your ideas? I want to know if it is too much.
Thank you for the report you gave me. It was very good. I have a few questions about the last part. Could you write more about that?
I notice a problem with our plan for next month, and I am not able to deal with it on my own. Could you look at it and tell me what you think?
Your group has done good work, and I want to hear more about how you approach it. Write to me and mention what was hard for you.
I have a new offer at work, and I hope to decide before the end of the week. I am aware that it could change a lot for me. What would you do?
I read your work, and I think the outcome is good. Before we go on, I would like to hear how you assess the last part. Your perspective on it matters to me.
I must decide something hard at work this week, and I am not sure what is right. I would value your view before I move on.

subject_en: Your view on the new plan
body_en: The new plan is open to us all, and I would like to know what you make of it. Some parts of it seem crucial to me, and others less so.
